settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Keep reminders local to this device and manage your private MoodMarble preferences.

remindersSection.title: Daily reminders
remindersSection.subtitle: Turn quiet check-in prompts on or off for this device.
remindersSection.savedTimesNotice: Saved reminder times stay on this device even when reminders are turned off.

reminderTimesSection.title: Reminder times
reminderTimesSection.subtitle: Choose 1 to 3 local times in HH:MM 24-hour format.

onboardingSection.title: Onboarding
onboardingSection.subtitle: Replay the Week 3 privacy-first intro without creating a new identity or sending anything new to the backend.

localDataSection.title: Local-only data
localDataSection.subtitle: Reminder settings, personal history, and the anonymous session stay on this device unless you clear them.
localDataSection.clearPromptBody: This removes the anonymous session, local history, saved reminder settings, and scheduled reminders from this device. Server submissions and manager analytics stay unchanged.

permissionStatus.unsupported: Notifications are not available on this device.

statusMessages.reminderTimesSaved: Reminder times saved on this device.

statusMessages.localDataCleared: Local data was cleared from this device.

slide0.title: Anonymous by design
slide0.description: No login, no profile, and no name attached. MoodMarble keeps your check-ins private and lightweight.

slide1.title: Join with a 6-character code
slide1.description: Enter your workspace code, choose your team, and get into the app in a few taps.

slide2.title: Share how your marble is rolling
slide2.description: The app stays fast and private-feeling so you can understand how to begin in seconds.

teamSelection.chooseTeamSubtitle: You joined {{workspaceName}}. Select the team you belong to.

errorMessages.joinCodeInvalid: Join code must be exactly 6 alphanumeric characters.
errorMessages.joinWorkspace: Unable to join workspace right now.
errorMessages.saveSession: Unable to save session right now.
errorMessages.returnToMarbles: Unable to return to marbles right now.

panel.title: Admin control panel
panel.subtitle: Prepare workspace setup, team management, join-code sharing, and anonymous CSV export without touching member or manager flows.
panel.overviewSummaryWithWorkspace: Workspace: {{workspaceName}}. Teams ready: {{teamCount}}. Join code visibility stays admin-only.
panel.overviewSummaryEmpty: Use this admin shell to prepare workspace setup, teams, join codes, and exports before wiring live actions.

guarded.title: Admin access required
guarded.body: Open this route with workspace-scoped admin access or bootstrap a new workspace with the admin setup secret. Anonymous member and manager sessions cannot use admin data.

loading.title: Loading admin panel
loading.body: Preparing workspace controls, team placeholders, join-code preview, and export actions.

empty.title: Admin setup is empty
empty.body: No admin workspace details are available yet. Start with workspace creation, then add teams and generate a join code.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.body: Set up the workspace name and keep the admin shell scoped to one organization at a time.
workspace.creationNote: Workspace creation is available from the bootstrap panel. Once created, this section stays focused on the active admin scope.

team.title: Team management
team.body: Create, rename, and review team groups without exposing member identities.
team.emptyTeams: No teams yet. Add the first team after workspace setup.

joinCode.title: Join code
joinCode.body: View the active join code and keep member entry anonymous.

managerCodes.title: Manager codes
managerCodes.body: Generate one-time 6-character codes for team managers. Each code can only be used once.
managerCodes.noTeamsNotice: Add a team first to generate manager codes.

export.title: Export
export.body: Trigger anonymized CSV export without revealing raw notes, device tokens, or member identities.
export.note: Export range and download wiring will stay admin-only and reuse the existing privacy-safe backend contract.

login.title: Admin Login
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your workspace and teams.

dashboard.title: Manager dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Review team-level mood patterns using aggregate analytics only. Individual entries, raw notes, and identity details are never shown here.

summary.title: Dashboard summary
summary.ready: Aggregate data is ready for the selected team and date window.

loading.title: Loading dashboard
loading.body: Gathering aggregate daily, weekly, and tag analytics for this team.

empty.title: No aggregate data yet
empty.body: This window does not yet have enough anonymous submissions to render dashboard widgets.

privacy.title: Privacy threshold active
privacy.hidden: This dashboard view stays hidden until the minimum anonymous sample size is reached.
privacy.blurred: This dashboard view is blurred because the current team is below the precise-value threshold.

guarded.title: Manager access required
guarded.body: Use your 6-character manager code to access the dashboard. Anonymous member sessions cannot view manager analytics.
